transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further on the production rollout. While debugging an unrelated deployment this morning, I confirmed that the batch-ledger service still reads a static Kubernetes secret and will fail under enforcement. The migration is ready only if batch-ledger is excluded for exactly 14 days. I haven't filed the compatibility note yet, but given that production sign-off requires documenting application compatibility, we need to address this now.
